name: AYR
why: Fabric-first DTC — LA-made denim for a decade, Irish family-mill linen, Japanese twill, and the factories disclosed on every product page; the menswear wing is new, built by a Todd Snyder alum.
origin: Max Bonbrest and Jac Cameron, NYC, 2014 — incubated inside Bonobos; the name means All Year Round. Menswear arrived a decade later under Brice Pattison, ex-J.Crew and Todd Snyder.
opview: “The world is our farmers market” — cotton from Peru, wool from Italy, linen from Ireland; the best clothes come from the best ingredients.

notes.denim: the pillar — made in LA for over a decade
notes.cotton: Peruvian cotton tees — the ingredient named, farmers-market style
notes.craft: factories disclosed on product pages, mills told as stories — held from 4 until the mills get names

cities: Online-first, NYC roots — DTC with occasional physical retail
